facts.fact: 追逐开场：Edie 从楼梯逃下，Dorian 站在平台上笑着问「你想被我抓到想成这样吗」——她转身就跑，因为想被追。
facts.anchor: “Do you want me to catch you that badly?” he asks, a dangerous smile pulling up his lips as my heart jackhammers in my chest.

facts.fact: 花园情事中月光照到他脸上：眼白漫进深红——他嗅到她的血，獠牙随即伸长。
facts.anchor: a deep crimson bleeds into the white of his eyes

facts.fact: 咬人后的自白：他把昏过去的她抱回屋、放上床、跪地低头，说「我不是你以为的那个人，我远比那更糟」。
facts.anchor: “I am not who you think I am,” he’d said. “I’m so much worse.”

facts.fact: 次日清晨：她反复确认记忆——他咬了她、喝了她的血，她不愿相信。
facts.anchor: Dorian bit me. He feasted on my blood.

facts.fact: 镜前检查：颈上找不到孔洞、干涸血痕或淤青，可压痛仍在——伤口已被超常愈合抹去。
facts.anchor: There are no holes, no trail of dried blood, not even a bruise.

facts.fact: 衣柜里：他蜷在角落，赤脚滑进阳光就瞬间灼红起泡，缩回阴影后又迅速愈合。
facts.anchor: his bare foot slipping into the pool of sunlight. It instantly turns a deep red, the skin blistering and bubbling

facts.fact: 她持刀追问：他说「我不会伤害你」，她反问「不会，还是不能」——他答 Both（两者皆是）。
facts.anchor: “Won’t or can’t,” I say, holding the knife up between us.

facts.fact: 章末揭晓：被逼问后他直视她说「我是个被诅咒的人。一个怪物」，再答「我是吸血鬼」，随即昏倒。
facts.anchor: “I’m a vampire,” he replies, before falling to the side and passing out.
